name: @milaboratories/github-ci-npm-split-publish
description: Split npm publish: pack on the build runner, upload from a GitHub-hosted runner with npm trusted publishing.

scripts.build: rm -rf lib dist && tsc && ncc build dist/bin/pack.js --minify --out lib/pack --source-map && ncc build dist/bin/publish.js --minify --out lib/publish --source-map && ncc build dist/bin/prepare.js --minify --out lib/prepare --source-map
